cards.say: How do you write the number zero in words? It is spelled Z, E, R, O. Zero.
How do you write the number one in words? It is spelled O, N, E. One.
How do you write the number two in words? It is spelled T, W, O. Two.
How do you write the number three in words? It is spelled T, H, R, E, E. Three.
How do you write the number four in words? It is spelled F, O, U, R. Four.
How do you write the number five in words? It is spelled F, I, V, E. Five.
How do you write the number six in words? It is spelled S, I, X. Six.
How do you write the number seven in words? It is spelled S, E, V, E, N. Seven.
How do you write the number eight in words? It is spelled E, I, G, H, T. Eight.
How do you write the number nine in words? It is spelled N, I, N, E. Nine.
How do you write the number ten in words? It is spelled T, E, N. Ten.
How do you write the number eleven in words? It is spelled E, L, E, V, E, N. Eleven.
How do you write the number twelve in words? It is spelled T, W, E, L, V, E. Twelve.
How do you write the number thirteen in words? It is spelled T, H, I, R, T, E, E, N. Thirteen.
How do you write the number fourteen in words? It is spelled F, O, U, R, T, E, E, N. Fourteen.
How do you write the number fifteen in words? It is spelled F, I, F, T, E, E, N. Fifteen.
How do you write the number sixteen in words? It is spelled S, I, X, T, E, E, N. Sixteen.
How do you write the number seventeen in words? It is spelled S, E, V, E, N, T, E, E, N. Seventeen.
How do you write the number eighteen in words? It is spelled E, I, G, H, T, E, E, N. Eighteen.
How do you write the number nineteen in words? It is spelled N, I, N, E, T, E, E, N. Nineteen.
How do you write the number twenty in words? It is spelled T, W, E, N, T, Y. Twenty.
What number comes after nineteen? Twenty.
What number comes before ten? Nine.
Count back from five to zero. Five, four, three, two, one, zero. Zero means none.
